description: Projection of the four vSphere Automation API operations used by the vCenter tagging inventory integration. Derived from the OpenAPI specification listed in docs/official_sources.json, not from a documentation page.

query_serialization.rule: OpenAPI 3.0 style=form, explode=true for every query parameter below.
query_serialization.array_parameter: Each member becomes a repeated key, e.g. names=alpha&names=beta.
query_serialization.object_parameter: Each set property of the object becomes its own top level key, e.g. marker=<opaque>&page_size=25. The object's own parameter name (iterate) never appears on the wire.
query_serialization.omission: A property or parameter that is not set is left out of the query string entirely. It is never sent as an empty value such as marker= or page_size=.

operations.summary: Creates a session with the API. This is the equivalent of login.

201.description: Newly created session token to be used for authenticating further requests.

notes: The 201 body is a bare JSON string, not an object.
The session token is sent on every later call in the vmware-api-session-id header.

operations.summary: Terminates the validity of a session token.
Returns categories that match the specified filter and iteration.

parameters.name: names
parameters.description: Categories need to have a name equal to one of the strings in this set to match the filter. If missing or null, then categories with any name match this filter.

parameters.name: iterate
parameters.description: The specification of a page to be retrieved. If missing or null, the first page will be retrieved.

400.description: If marker and filter are supplied together.

404.description: If the supplied marker value is not valid.

operations.summary: Returns tags that match the specified filter and iteration.

parameters.name: names
parameters.description: Tags need to have a name equal to one of the strings in this set to match the filter. If missing or null, then tags with any name match this filter.

parameters.name: iterate
parameters.description: The specification of a page to be retrieved. If missing or null, the first page will be retrieved.

400.description: If marker and filter are supplied together.

404.description: If the supplied marker value is not valid.

marker.description: Opaque token that requests the next page of categories. If missing or null, the first page of categories will be returned.

page_size.description: Used for pagination to fetch given page size. If missing or null, then categories will be fetched with default size of 20.

marker.description: Opaque token that requests the next page of categories. If missing or null, then all the categories have been returned.
Opaque token that requests the next page of tags. If missing or null, the first page of tags will be returned.

page_size.description: Used for pagination to fetch given page size. If missing or null, then tags will be fetched with default page size of 20.

marker.description: Opaque token that requests the next page of tags. If missing or null, then all the tags have been returned.

Vapi.Std.Errors.Error.note: Vapi.Std.Errors.Unauthenticated, Unauthorized, NotFound, InvalidArgument and ServiceUnavailable all carry this same shape.

pagination.next_page: Send the marker returned by the previous page.
pagination.termination: Stop when the response has no marker property or its marker is the empty string.
pagination.filter_conflict: A filter (names) and a marker cannot be supplied on the same request; the server answers 400 InvalidArgument.
